questions.prompt: GTA 6 preloads just went live — the download bar is filling tonight and the city opens soon. Which scene sounds most like yours right now?

options.text: Download's running — I'm in the city the second the doors open.
Steady — letting the download finish while I take my time.
Just watching the hype roll by, easy tonight.
My head's already bouncing between the download bar and the city.

questions.prompt: Somewhere in Hyrule there's a little melody only the scarecrow knows — and unlocking it takes a bit of wandering tonight. When a tiny secret is hiding in a big world, where does it pull you?

options.text: Tracking it down — one clue at a time till the song's mine.
Wandering easy — the song will find me when it finds me.
My head's full of half-remembered tunes and wrong turns.
Drifting with the quest — Hyrule decides where tonight goes.

questions.prompt: GTA 6 just became the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history — millions already locked in before launch night. Where do you land in the rush?

options.text: Pre-ordered already — locked in and counting down.
Waiting to see — I'll decide when the reviews land.
Skipping the rush — my backlog's a city of its own.
Torn between the hype and my wallet.

questions.prompt: Season 3 of The Rings of Power is big and dense — a whole evening of Middle-earth to sink into tonight. If someone handled the wind-down drink for your long watch, what would you want in your hands?

options.text: A slow mug of herbal tea — settling in for a long night in Middle-earth.
Hot chocolate — warm, sweet, and nowhere to be tonight.
Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Big Walk is a game about nothing but walking — slow steps, open trail, friends alongside. Tonight, which sound is the sound of a good walk for you?

options.text: Soft footsteps and a low hum — the trail at its own pace.
Friends chatting along the way — the walk's better shared.
Just the night air — no music, no noise, only the path.
An upbeat trail mix — every step's got a little bounce.

questions.prompt: The Scarecrow Song is yours now — a little tune tucked away in Hyrule, waiting to be played. The next hour is yours. What should it feel like?

options.text: Humming the tune as I wander — no plan, just the night.
Showing a friend the trick — the best secrets are shared.
Deep in the world — the song opens doors I haven't tried yet.
Restless — one secret found and now I want them all.
